chunks: And ʿAbdullāh ibn Sinān asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
about a man who wants to marry a woman: may he look at her hair?
He said: “Yes. He only intends to acquire her for the highest price.”

key_terms.الثَّمَنِ: the price, indicating the gravity and costliness mentioned in the report
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةَ: the woman being considered for marriage
key_terms.يَشْتَرِيَهَا: to acquire her, used here in the hadith’s wording regarding marriage

ai.seo_question: Can a man look at a woman’s hair before marrying her according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a man who intends to marry a woman, permitting him to look at her hair. The wording indicates that this allowance is connected to the seriousness and consequence of marriage, which is described here in terms of acquiring at a great price.
